subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: What should OpenClaw's Google provider do with same-route visible textSignature values: preserve them, drop them, cap them, or store them outside replayed session context?
rationale: Current code intentionally replays valid same-route Gemini signatures, but the issue shows visible-text signatures can create unbounded session/context bloat; choosing which signatures are required is a provider contract decision.

options.title: Bound visible text signatures
options.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures, but cap, externalize, or omit visible-text signatures from replay so ordinary answers cannot bloat future requests.

options.title: Preserve current replay
options.body: Keep all valid same-route signatures in replay and accept the session-size risk until stronger upstream evidence says visible-text signatures are optional.

options.title: Strip all Google signatures
options.body: Remove every Google signature from replay, which is simpler but risks breaking valid tool-call or native-thinking continuity.

recommendation.title: Bound visible text signatures
recommendation.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures, but cap, externalize, or omit visible-text signatures from replay so ordinary answers cannot bloat future requests.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current line-blame carrier for the inspected replay/storage code and has recent Google transport history.
